engine: Houdini Engine for UE 5.8 FREE (up to 10 licenses, Indie 3 FREE)
description: Async-cook HDA for Melodia lookdev — replaces PIL rasterizer, outputs Nanite mesh + T_* + manifest

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.label: Determinism Seed
parameters.help: Every RNG node (Labs Baker jitter, OIDN) uses this. Changing it invalidates Saved/Audit/melusina_lookdev/houdini_variants/* QA renders.

parameters.name: Resolution
parameters.label: Bake Resolution
parameters.help: File Output COP resolution. 1024 for dress, 2048+ for terrain.

parameters.name: BakeSet
parameters.label: Texture Set
parameters.help: Which UE texture stem to output. Must match melodia_v2_material_map.json convention.

parameters.name: Denoise
parameters.label: OIDN Denoise
parameters.help: Enable OpenImageDenoise COP (2s). Disable for debugging raw 64-ray AO speckle.

parameters.name: ThicknessBias
parameters.label: Thickness Bias
parameters.help: Post-scale on f@thickness VEX (Cd.r). For thin-vs-thick fabric tuning.

parameters.name: BackgroundAO
parameters.label: AO Background
parameters.help: COP Attribute Interpolate background for AO (must stay 1.0 — verified in dress_ao_raster_manifest.json)

inputs.name: Posed Mesh
inputs.description: Posed OBJ from Pass A (shorewake_all_meshes.obj) or USDZ 48MAT. Y-up, cm.

nodes: Attribute Interpolate (Ao, bg 1.0 — exact, same as bake_rasterize_ao.py note)
File Output ×4 (BaseColor BC7 sRGB, Normal BC5 linear, Roughness BC4 linear, Emissive gray)
cop_network.cache: COP Cache COP after Denoise — re-cook only on Seed/Resolution change

nodes: AttribWrangle VEX_geometry_attrs (thickness ray + convex/concave Laplacian → Cd)
AttribWrangle VEX_AO_64 (64 rays, cosine hemisphere, self-exclusion 0.001, seed)

unreal_contract.material: MI_Melusina_Dress_Shorewake on M_Master_Toon_Universal (Albedo+Normal+Emissive wired 2026-08-29, added bUseEmissiveMap)
unreal_contract.mesh: SK_ShorewakeDress_Magical.fbx (268281 verts, 48 slots, 5 morphs) — weight lab blocked until hython license verified

rollout.phase: SOP VEX proven (already), PIL rasterizer live, Copernicus HIP scaffold landed this commit (dry), HDA cook blocked until hserver -l license verified
rollout.fallback: Keep PIL rasterizer until COP File Outputs match PIL outputs byte-identical on seed 20260828 (compare via Tools/verify_tex_contract.py)
